label: Figure 20.6: Changing rates of inflation and deflation
alt: Line chart of a hypothetical inflation rate, 1999 to 2005: 1.8, 3.1, 2.4, 1.5, 0.6, -0.7 and -0.2 percent. It peaks in 2000, falls every year to 2004 and turns negative from 2004.
caption: Hypothetical inflation rates: 1.8% (1999), 3.1% (2000), 2.4%, 1.5%, 0.6% (2003), then −0.7% (2004) and −0.2% (2005). From 2001 to 2003 the rate is falling but still positive, which is disinflation; in 2004 and 2005 it is below zero, which is deflation (the price level itself is falling).
